description: Assign each approved action to one primary system and represent overlaps as linked secondary records.

onboarding.question: Which system should own each kind of action, and how should overlaps be linked?
setup_questions: Which configured systems may be primary destinations: GTD, Jira, or CRM?
Should team, delegated, multi-step, or acceptance-criteria work route to Jira?
Should personal next actions and waiting-fors route to GTD?
Should CRM receive linked records instead of duplicate executable actions?
